entities.name: Malanai
entities.description: A human born among the Hurloon in northern Aerona, in the home of the minotaur Hamu; her name means "Morning Star".

entities.name: Ikenet
entities.description: Malanai's mother, a trained acrobat taken in by Hamu; she later left Hurloon with Malanai.

entities.name: Hamu
entities.description: A Hurloon minotaur who sheltered Ikenet and Malanai and was chosen Consort by Makura.

entities.name: Makura
entities.description: The Great Mother of the Hurloon, who chose Hamu as her Consort.

entities.name: Herhoona
entities.description: An arrogant Hurloon male who won the wrestling contest and was executed for charging Makura.

entities.name: Hurloon
entities.description: Minotaur people among whom Malanai was born.

events.summary: Ikenet performs with Hamu in the annual contest, earning Makura's favor.
events.quote: Ikenet performed together with Hamu, earning the Great Mother Makura 's favor

events.summary: Herhoona wins the wrestling contest, but Makura chooses Hamu as Consort again.
events.quote: Makura chose Hamu as her Consort once again

events.summary: Herhoona charges Makura and is tackled and executed.
events.quote: executed by one of the Grandmothers for endangering a Mother and her child
